name: proj-work-breakdown-structure
description: Breaks the project into a deliverable tree down to work packages, with a 100% rule check, optional WBS dictionary rows, a proposed owner per package and a gaps list of forgotten work. Use for "run proj-work-breakdown-structure", "build a WBS", "break down this project", "work breakdown structure", "what does done contain", "decompose the deliverables", "list the work packages", "what are we forgetting", part of the AI for Project Management Pack by 90n.
